class.name: ToastProxy
class.brief_description: ContextProxy entry held by ActivityManager's toast queue.
class.description: Created by [method Context.show_toast]. In SERIAL display mode the proxy stays in [constant ContextProxy.STATE_PENDING] until it pops to the front of the queue and is shown; in PARALLEL mode it transitions to READY immediately.

method.name: get_toast
method.description: Returns the attached [Toast], or [code]null[/code] if the node has not been shown / has been freed.
